name: Leadership
description: Radical candor feedback, delegation clarity, alignment under stress, and accountability enforcement.

dimensions.name: Radical Candor & Feedback
dimensions.description: Direct, empathetic, uncompromising critique without ruinous empathy or obnoxious aggression.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Directly addresses poor performance with compassion and objective examples; clears air.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Constructive feedback delivered well with slight sugar-coating.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Ruinous empathy: withholds hard truth to avoid uncomfortable tension.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Passive-aggressive evasion or toxic demoralizing outburst.

dimensions.name: Delegation & Outcome Ownership
dimensions.description: Defining 'What done looks like', context, constraints, and deadline without micromanagement.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Delegates ownership not tasks; sets clear success metrics and check-in cadence.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good task delegation with minor ambiguity on edge-case scenarios.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Vague instructions followed by frustration when result misses expectations.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Dumps tasks without context or micromanages every keystroke.
